page.layout: One page of text in a single column. Marginal notes in the right margin, letters a, b and c. At the foot the gathering signature L, centred, and the catchword Quid at the right.

l.i: Dixit enim Dominus Petro, Pasce Oves; & audivit etiam è cœlo

main_text.l: vocem, Occide & manduca:-- Nempè, quando cùm Leonibus &
feris animalibus agendū; iubetur Petrus occidere; obsistere sc.

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "modò" has a blot after "mod", read as modò[?]. "Hem.VIII." in note b is printed as seen; the reading of the abbreviation is uncertain. A sign like a tilde stands above "Armorum", unclear meaning, not transcribed. The printed "compendiosam,non" has no space after the comma, kept as printed. "minisferium" is read as ministerium, the st ligature looks like "ff". "ve-fster" is the printed hyphenation, the word is unclear. Ink blots in both margins and at the bottom left, and a dot after "Iesuita", are not printed text and are not transcribed.
